Families in Nuevo Laredo can plan for a four-day school break around Día de Muertos, according to El Mañana de Nuevo Laredo and Mexico's official school calendar.

The break runs from Friday, October 30 through Monday, November 2, with students returning to classrooms on Tuesday, November 3, according to the Secretariat of Public Education (SEP) 2026-2027 calendar.

Friday, October 30 is a School Technical Council (CTE) session day, when teachers and administrators meet to review educational progress and plan strategies, so students do not attend classes that day, according to SEP calendar reporting.

Monday, November 2 is a suspension of teaching duties for Día de Muertos. Together with the weekend of October 31 and November 1, that makes four consecutive days without school activities for preschool, primary, and secondary students in public and private schools in the National Education System.

Parents should note the break applies to students, not necessarily to workers: November 2 is not listed as a mandatory rest day under Mexico's Federal Labor Law, according to SEP calendar reporting.

Sources:

  • El Mañana de Nuevo Laredo, "Confirmar megapuente por Día de Muertos en Nuevo Laredo; autorizan suspensión de clases en Tamaulipas," October 26, 2026
  • ViveUSA, "SEP confirms 4-day 'megapuente' in October for preschool, elementary, and middle school"

title: Día de Muertos Brings a 4-Day School Break in Nuevo Laredo
